name: governance
description: 通用代码治理运行时——PostToolUse 声明式规则门禁（block 违规 exit 2）+ 验证机器凭证（DoD 审计链）+ 哈希链事件流 + SessionStart 完整性自保护 + 轮统计。规则/关键词/验证约定全部外置配置，运行时零领域假设；领域规则经 domain pack 或项目 .qgw/ 接入。

description_i18n.en: Universal code governance runtime — declarative PostToolUse rule gating (block via exit 2) + verification machine receipts (DoD audit chain) + hash-chained event stream + SessionStart integrity self-check + per-turn stats. All rules/keywords/verify conventions are external config; domain rules plug in via domain packs or project .qgw/.
